problem_type: Inspector input commit/cancel and history boundaries differ by input channel
symptom: Escape or an empty numeric draft writes zero on blur; range keyboard changes and some color/name/toggle changes cannot be individually undone.
direct_cause: Two numeric fields coerce null/empty strings with Number; gesture history is wired only to pointerdown; several discrete inspectors call raw setters.
class_root: Shared field primitives do not own a commit/cancel lifecycle covering text, keyboard, pointer, and color input channels; discrete mutations lack a transaction boundary.
affected_population: Camera names/ray, light names/shadows, scene label/grid/snap toggles
internal_only_reason: Internal React field lifecycle and director history contract; no dependency capability or version change.
invariants: Empty/cancelled numeric drafts do not commit
Valid changed input commits once through the same parser
Every control mutation has a prior history boundary
Read-only transforms expose no editable control
Continuous clip slider gestures retain one history snapshot across all changes
generality_proof: Both number renderers consume one draft hook; gesture changes call onChangeStart at first mutation across keyboard/pointer channels; discrete inspectors call withHistory.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Own numeric draft validation and cancellation
Begin history on actual keyboard/pointer mutation
Begin history for color clear/custom input as well as swatches
Let shared field gestures own one snapshot while discrete timeline edits keep an independent history entry

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Same hook/parser for text; first actual range change triggers snapshot.
Discrete changes are wrapped in withHistory.

same_class_scan: Read all panels/fields and Camera/Light/SceneLayer inspectors
rg onChange/onCommit/onChangeStart/saveState across all panels/inspector, then inspected Character/Primitive/Closeup/Action/LookAt/Transform/Waypoint paths
recurrence.reason: All field instances and all keyboard users can repeat the same lifecycle mechanism.

prevention.strategy: One numeric draft lifecycle for both renderers; all input modalities enter mutation history consistently
prevention.failure_mode: Cancel or invalid draft clears local text without changing project
prevention.invariant: Only finite changed drafts commit; cancel/null/blank never writes

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove duplicated Number(draft) coercion and pointer-only history entry.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Uses existing React hooks and history contract; no dependency change.

migration: No persisted schema change; existing controls consume the corrected primitives.
residual_risks: 17 field browser cases passed; continuous trajectory/action/closeup/single/batch slider cases passed in waypoint-ui-green.log; coordinator owns full desktop integration.

invariant_owner_layer.why: 不变量由 src/workbench/generationCanvas/nodes/director/panels/fields/useNumberDraft.ts 单点持有（即本合同的 prevention.enforcement_path / shared_boundaries）；上游其它入口只调用它、不各自重判。tests 是该层现有的类级与回归测试，改动这条不变量必先让它们红。
